name: Residencia Temporal -- Students Subcategory

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national admitted to a state-recognized Chilean educational institution applies for the Students subcategory of Residencia Temporal through SERMIG.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Enrollment certificate from a state-recognized institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Enrollment at a state-recognized Chilean educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a state-recognized Chilean institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Criminal/judicial record certificate (applicants 18+), from country of origin or last 5 years' residence.

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years, extendable for two consecutive years

sources.title: serviciomigraciones.cl (Chile's Servicio Nacional de Migraciones, SERMIG) -- Residencia Temporal overview: lists 'Students -- from state-recognized educational institutions' as one of 15 subcategories, sharing the general 2-year duration and core document requirements (passport, criminal record certificate, photo)
